selected_evidence.requirement: Baseline: node2 and node3 can directly exchange traffic before isolation is applied
selected_evidence.summary: Pre-change pings between node2 (10.100.151.11) and node3 (10.100.151.12) succeed with ttl=64, proving direct L2/L3 reachability prior to isolation.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 reachable on the shared subnet (prerequisite for isolation requirement)
selected_evidence.summary: Diagnosed that node1's eth0 (not eth1) is the real data-plane NIC; journal shows DHCPACK of 10.100.151.10; corrected the earlier stray eth1 static address; confirmed node2 and node3 can ping node1 at 10.100.151.10.

selected_evidence.requirement: Port isolation applied: node2 and node3 cannot exchange traffic directly
selected_evidence.summary: iptables DROP rules installed on node2 and node3 targeting each other's IP; verification pings show 100% loss / permission-denied sendmsg between node2 and node3 in both directions.

selected_evidence.requirement: Both node2 and node3 continue to reach node1 while isolated from each other
selected_evidence.summary: Same verification commands show successful ping replies from 10.100.151.10 (node1) alongside the failed peer-to-peer pings, confirming selective isolation.

No iptables-persistent package available; wrote idempotent iptables re-apply commands into /etc/rc.local on node2 and node3 and confirmed rc-local.service is loaded and enabled (static) and had previously executed successfully at last boot.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Captured baseline boot_id 5f292bc7...; issued /sbin/reboot via nohup+disown so the ack returned before disconnect; polled until exec returned; new boot_id c8037128... proves the restart occurred; post-restart eth0 re-acquired 10.100.151.10 via DHCP, all SONiC containers (database, swss, bgp, teamd, syncd, gbsyncd, radv, sysmgr, eventd) reported Up, and node2/node3 could ping node1 again while isolation between them remained intact.

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Captured baseline boot_id cef219e3... immediately before issuing sudo reboot (nohup+disown); connection-refused during the outage window confirms the reboot took effect; new boot_id 7a57df29... proves the restart; post-restart verification shows the DROP rules re-applied from rc.local (node2 cannot reach node3, sendmsg denied) and node2 can still ping node1.

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Captured baseline boot_id 2f708738... immediately before issuing sudo reboot; connection-refused during the outage window confirms reboot; new boot_id 48ae9a1f... proves the restart; post-restart verification shows DROP rules re-applied from rc.local (node3 cannot reach node2), node3 can still ping node1, and a final cross-check from node2 confirms node2 also still cannot reach node3 and can still reach node1.
